# Sam Okafor — VP Engineering

> Note: there are **two Sams** on Maya's leadership team. This is **Sam Okafor, VP Engineering**
> (product engineering). The other is [Sam Whitfield](sam-whitfield.md), Head of Security.
> Do not conflate them.

- **Relationship:** Maya's direct report. Owns product engineering (~70 engineers across
  feature teams). Joined Novaflow in 2020; promoted to VP in 2024.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Mondays 14:00; skip-levels with his EMs monthly.
- **Owns:** [Onboarding Revamp](../projects/onboarding-revamp.md); contributes app-side work to
  [Atlas Migration](../projects/atlas-migration.md).
- **Distinguishing fact:** started his career as a **payments** engineer; he is the interim
  backfill covering the Payments team after [Tom Becker](tom-becker.md) departed.

## How to work with him
- Pragmatic shipper; will cut scope to hit a date and tell you plainly.
- Wants clear priority calls from Maya when product and platform pull his teams apart.
- Strong at people leadership; a bit light on deep infra — leans on Raj for platform calls.

## Sensitivities
- Stretched thin covering Payments; needs the EM backfill closed soon.
